arms.full: matched diagnostic Wild runs the entire link, including the normal writer
arms.oracle: all standard input discovery/symbol resolution, followed by width-specific admitted stored ELF, BLAKE3-authenticated and republished through standard Wild file writer; prior selected inputs assumed free
arms.selected: same as oracle plus per-actual-selected input byte digests and comparison against the independently registered width-specific known fixture; it is still not a complete digest of the full semantic closure

class: upper-bound feasibility only; neither oracle establishes a shippable input proof
cpu: H1 CPUs 16–23, named native lock, 8 Cargo jobs, release 16. Use a physically independent copy of the published Ruff setup at the same logical paths; all arms use one coherent target only with a per-command width-specific full ELF gate and a fresh before every actual edit.
endpoint: monotonic wall ns for full fresh-process ordinary cargo +ohm test --no-run -p ruff_python_parser --locked --offline -j8 on the edit, no other work inside timer
gate: Pursue an actual general deployable proof here only if selected is at least 2% median faster, wins at least 10/12 paired blocks and Holm p<.05 with every selection/native gate valid; otherwise no product timing/PR from this experiment.
invariants: exact reference 148 full artifact roster, immediate no-op, one full trivia+2 link-only before timing
64 direct links cover both states and widths 1–8 with exact packaged ELF hashes before admission

full selected and known gold ELF each match both canonical outcomes by observed true worker width; each timed invocation must be successful and exactly 2 per-target Wild entries and their expected admission status
gate target native bytes and 3 terminal ELFs and correct ordinary changed caller outside timing; no Ruff tests
control source states with the historical patch and separately run full reset whenever necessary; unscored resets retained
no ordinary scored run before full participant hashes and this schedule are frozen; any refusal/mismatch retained and halts; source restoration after exit
summary: Report signed paired median percent cuts for both contrasts, 12 paired log ratios, binomial order-statistic median interval, exact sign test Holm across full:oracle and full:selected, all direction counts. Wall evidence labels the private fixture upper-bound only.
